verdict.rationale: The evidence documents outbound payments, received debits, and instant funding from a Stripe payments balance. None of it mentions domestic wires, RTP, or FedNow, for either origination or receipt, and there are no per-rail capability docs. The 'Instant' label describes an internal transfer from the Stripe payments balance, not an external faster-payment rail, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, the faster rails are there when I need them — domestic wires, RTP, and FedNow origination and receipt through the same API, with per-rail capabilities documented
